crossRefs.note: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods…
“I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
He arose, and immediately took up the mat, and went out in front of them all; so that they were all amazed, and…
As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious…
